references.text: God promises to send the hornet ahead of the Israelites to drive out the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites, which is directly mentioned in Joshua 24:12.
Moses prophesies that the Lord will send the hornet against the peoples whom the Israelites fear, until those who remain and hide are destroyed.
God explains that He will drive out the enemies little by little before the Israelites, not all at once.

The psalmist confirms that it was not by their own sword that they took possession of the land, but by God's right hand and the light of His face, which corresponds to the statement that it was not with sword or bow.
Describes Israel's victory over the two Amorite kings Sihon and Og, who are the two kings mentioned in Joshua 24:12.
God declares that He has begun to put fear and dread of Israel upon all peoples under heaven.
